title: Learning Distributed Equilibria in Linear-Quadratic Stochastic Differential Games: An $α$-Potential Approach
summary: We analyze independent policy-gradient (PG) learning in $N$-player linear-quadratic (LQ) stochastic differential games. Each player employs a distributed policy that depends only on its own state and updates the policy independently using the gradient of its own objective. We establish global linear convergence of these methods to an equilibrium by showing that the LQ game admits an $α$-potential structure, with $α$ determined by the degree of pairwise interaction asymmetry.
